name: CLAVIS-M3
definition: Views: DINOv2 B/14 and L/14, same support (12 shots) / calibration (4 shots) split and CLIP candidate sets K(x) as CLAVIS.

Static view (proto): r_c(x) = 1 - cos(f(x), normalised mean of the 12 support shots of class c); class statistics from leave-one-out prototype distances (median / MAD x 1.4826, shrunk with n0 = 12); d = min over K(x) of the robust z; p, p_all conformal against the calibration shots.

Memory (per view): iterated two-stage entrance C1 = {p_all <= 0.40}, C2 = {p_C1 <= 0.30}, M = {p_C2 <= 0.10}; p_t = conformal p of g = d - (r_M - med_all)/mad_all (kNN statistics of the support for the memory scale), recomputed per batch.

Label propagation (per view): kNN graph (k = 10, weights max(cos,0)^3, symmetric max, D^-1/2 W D^-1/2) over support shots (label 1), calibration shots and the stream so far (batch b joins before it is scored); f = 15 iterations of f <- 0.9 W f + 0.1 y (warm start); p_LP = rank of f among the calibration shots.
Score = S_final * prod of the four p-values. No training, no weights; LP hyper-parameters were set a priori (not tuned).

selection_on_dev1.explored: whitening (no gain), extra views g/14 and CLIP image (no gain), joint cross-view admission (worse), stream-density admission (far drop), iterated two-stage admission (+0.4 to +0.8), prototype static views (+0.9 to +1.9 with iterated admission), conformal label propagation (+2.6 with prototype views)
selection_on_dev1.frozen_before: any ablation of this configuration was run
